name: Elena north mouth · bougainvillea, lantern and CALLE DE ELENA tiles on the corner patio wall
about: Show-details pieces on lane_walls.json elena-north-corner-patio-wall (segment 0 runs from the house corner along the Elena north lane to the corner, segment 1 from the corner west along Cervantes): climbers by segment, 'from'/'to' metres along it, 'side' the face they grow on, 'base' the height above the lane the leafy mass starts (bare trained 'stems' below it, from the bed top), 'sparse' a drape without a dark backing; the lantern 'at' metres along, 'y' its bracket height, 'out' its reach; the sign's 'centre' metres along, one tile ('tileW' x 'tileH') per letter. Drawn by src/elena-north-corner-details.ts. Positions read by eye from unsolved ground photos, about 0.3-0.5 m.

climbers.basis: Bougainvillea spilling over the top of the plaque run from the corner to past the door, about 0.6 m down the face and 0.3-0.5 m above the coping, the letters left readable (IMG_2800, IMG_2455, IMG_2966, IMG_2967; detail review D2).

The bulk of the bougainvillea over the Cervantes face from the corner westwards, flowering from about 1.4 m up and over the coping, bare trained stems below from the bed (IMG_2455, IMG_2800, IMG_2966, IMG_2799; detail review D2).
More bougainvillea over the wall above the hedge and plumbago, by the Elena 24 garden door (IMG_2463, IMG_2462).

lamp.basis: Black lantern on an iron bracket on the Cervantes face just round the corner, among the bougainvillea, about 2.3 m up (IMG_2800 left of the wall edge, IMG_2455, IMG_2966; structure review fits).

sign.basis: CALLE DE ELENA in tall, narrow single-letter tiles (about 0.08 x 0.21 m: CALLE is 125 x 65 px in IMG_2967), dark capitals on white, about 1.1 m long, from the corner to the door's south jamb on the face to the Elena north lane, bottom about 1.9 m up (IMG_2800, IMG_2967, IMG_2455; structure review fits). Detail review D3: moved south off the door; with the recorded 0.2-0.3 m corner offset only about 1.15 m of face lies between the door jamb and the modelled corner, so the tiles are drawn 0.075 m wide with 0.06 m word gaps to fit it.
